extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: Do NOT use speechManager.speak() anywhere in the game. Only use audioManager.play() for sound effects. Valid sound effects: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint. The game must teach: (1) Animal types — pets live with us (dog, cat), wild animals live in forests (lion, tiger, elephant), domestic animals live on farms (cow, goat, hen). (2) Habitats — land (cow, lion), water (fish, frog), air (bird, butterfly). (3) Body parts — birds have wings and beaks, fish have fins and scales, elephants have trunks and tusks. (4) Care — feed animals, give them water, keep them clean, do not hurt them. Misconceptions: 'all animals live in the same place' (each has its own home), 'pet and domestic are the same' (pets live in home, domestic live on farms), 'all animals have the same body parts' (birds have wings, fish have fins, elephants have trunks). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function AnimalTypesGame), NOT export default. Export interface AnimalTypesGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
